messages:
deploy-bot: Promotion request received for service=payments chart=payments-chart version=2.14.0 -> staged to canary in eu-west and us-central. Preflight: running chart-compat-check and canary health probes. @maya requested.

maya: kicking off canary manually because prod traffic spike earlier blocked automated window. dropping a note here in case we need to pin.

anna: quick FYI the chart-compat-check flagged a CRD field change between 2.13.x and 2.14.0: `spec.retryPolicy` -> `spec.retry.policy` path moved. Canary pods start but controller logs show schema warnings.

leo: paste of the controller warning: ```
W 02:14:12 controller.go:234 schema validation failed: unknown field "retryPolicy" in payments.v1.PaymentSpec
```

anna: e2e smoke passed, but that warning could cause sidecars to ignore retries. We should consider pinning to 2.13.8 for now or apply a values shim to map fields.

miguel: thanks. can we aggregate signals before deciding? current policy calls for >2 critical health signals across regions -> cancel. but we should include the chart-compat-check as a signal too.

maya: yes please. I'm seeing slow error rate uptick in eu-west canary: 0.6% -> 3.2% after a deploy. us-central looks OK.

sre-oncall: from infra/metrics: cpu and p95 latencies are flat. but payment-failure-rate spike correlates with canary rollout start at +2m.

miguel: proposal: signal-aggregation rule for this promotion: fail if any TWO of the following are true within 10m of canary start: (1) canary health checks failing in >1 region, (2) error-rate >2% absolute increase vs baseline, (3) chart-compat-check returns schema warnings for CRD fields used by workloads. If triggered, auto-abort and pin to previous stable (2.13.8). If only the chart-compat-check trips alone but no user-facing error, then hold and open a hotfix branch.

maya: +1. if it aborts, deploy-bot should create a pinned-release note and open a cherry-pick hotfix PR template.

deploy-bot: rule recorded: aggregation_rule_v3 applied to promotion. Will abort and pin if >=2 signals within 600s. Tracking canary ids: cny-1749994322-eu, cny-1749994322-us.

anna: thinking out loud: we could also try a values shim override to preserve `spec.retryPolicy` mapping for one release: add `legacy.retryPolicy: true` and translator init-container to remap. That avoids rolling back but is riskier long-term.

leo: how fast can we produce patch? I can cut a small chart patch that adds an admission hook for legacy mapping. But that requires another canary.

miguel: decision time: do we abort now and pin, or let it run an extra 10m for signal aggregation? I'm leaning to let aggregation finish — we've got one region degraded, need a second signal to fail. If it fails, pin and assemble rollback notes.

maya: agree. we'll let it run 10m. I'll monitor the eu-west logs. tagging @sre-oncall for escalation.

sre-oncall: will monitor alerts. If user-facing error crosses 5% impacted or payment queue backlog >2000, escalate to SEV.

(6m later)

leo: eu-west canary errors spiked again, now 3.9%. us-central still 0.4%. chart-compat-check still reporting the CRD warning. That's two signals (error-rate and compat-check).

miguel: ok abort. deploy-bot, execute abort-and-pin: target previous chart=payments-chart:2.13.8, create release-note draft, and open hotfix template PR with description of mapping issue.

deploy-bot: abort initiated. rolling back canaries and pinning chart to 2.13.8. Generated artifacts:
- release-note-draft: /releases/drafts/payments-2.13.8-pin-1749994322.md
- hotfix-PR-template: https://git.company/repo/pkgr/compare/hotfix/payments-legacy-mapping
- incident-draft: /incidents/drafts/payments-canary-compat-1749994322.md

maya: thanks everyone. tagging @miguel to confirm we want the hotfix path vs hold-and-skip for next release.

miguel: confirm hotfix path. we need a short postmortem in release notes: root cause = chart schema migration without translation shim; mitigation = pin + create rewrite shim and add chart-compat gating to preflight so schema warnings are considered a critical signal going forward.

anna: I'll file the followup tasks: add compat-check -> critical signal, add quick values-shim pattern doc, and add plugin to deploy-bot to auto-open hotfix PR with title template.

leo: I'll start the hotfix branch and aim for a quick patch that implements the init-container translator. ETA 3h.

sre-oncall: we cleared the payment queue backlog and errors have returned to baseline after rollback. I'll close the monitoring watch in 30m if stable. :white_check_mark:

miguel: nice work. update release notes and ping product for a note to customers about a brief canary interruption.

maya: copying release-note draft here: ```
- Action: pinned payments-chart to v2.13.8 after canary compatibility issues with v2.14.0
- Reason: schema field path changed; caused elevated error-rate in eu-west canary
- Next steps: hotfix branch to add translation shim; add compat-check -> critical signal
```

deploy-bot: thread closed by abort action. artifacts available in draft paths listed above.

miguel: leaving a followup: schedule a retro with PM and infra to decide on migration cadence.
